relative_to: CKAD47 DEV_NO_GO; source-research-only, accepted binary native API unchanged
hypothesis: A tokenless learned four-state/four-action causal effect model that infers which public state partition controls an action can compose genuinely state-dependent transitions, transfer to previously unseen action primitive IDs and retain earlier actions, beating a fully source-trained unrestricted per-(state,action) tabular predictor and a false XOR-invariance model, while staying within a strict margin of a full exact Bayesian structural class control.

physics.action_effect: Unobserved deterministic state-conditioned XOR delta per action: state_class is high state bit in world0 and parity(state bits) in world1. Each class maps actions 0..3 bijectively to XOR deltas 0..3; class1 mapping is a nontrivial derangement of class0. Transition p(intended state)=.9, p(each other state)=.1/3.
physics.reward: Observed terminal binary reward after two transitions, Bernoulli .9 or .1 of final-state truth; world0 reward parity of state bits, world1 reward OR of state bits.
physics.privacy: World's state-partition label and action-to-effect mappings and final true reward function are never passed to any learner, readout or source update; evaluator-only.
physics.data: Each public source episode includes s0,a1,s1,a2,s2,y; original actions 0/1 for first80, novel primitive actions 2/3 for next112, return to 0/1 final64; sample same real episode sequence and same real transition/reward outcomes across arms.
physics.source_seeds: 2 fresh DEV seeds x 2 worlds, 256 episodes each, 1024 observed public episodes and 3072 source consequences per platform; no replay of earlier seeds.

experimental_native.name: state_partition_gated_native
experimental_native.learned_banks: Four causal state-partition hypotheses: no partition; low bit; high bit; parity. Each hypothesis learns Dirichlet(.25) counts for action->observed XOR delta in each public state group. Independent four terminal reward-state Beta(1,1) cells. Source labels/receipts never include private true partition.
experimental_native.routing: Prequential Bayesian model evidence from each genuine observed action-state transition updates normalized posterior over the four candidate partitions. Readout uses posterior BMA unless one partition has posterior >=.90; then gates to that retained partition's predictive. No outcome from the current readout is used to select a hypothesis before prediction.
experimental_native.composed_reward: For each s0,a1,a2, marginalize over 4 next states and 4 possible final states using chosen partition predictions conditioned on publicly known intermediate state. Condition the *exact* structural control's posterior partition on hypothetical s1 before stage2 without training on that counterfactual, to avoid a weak factorized comparator.
experimental_native.persistence: All four partition banks and posterior state, source ledger and raw action IDs persist; action 2/3 effects are genuine four-valued primitives, not binary aliases; exact cold restoration, duplicate idempotence, conflicting identity atomicity.

strongest_controls.exact_structure_BMA: Independent exact Bayesian model averaging over the same FOUR state-partition classes, Dirichlet(.25) transition-cell posterior predictive per class and accumulated prequential evidence, with joint two-intervention conditioning on the same class posterior. No hard .90 gating. Full genuine-source training. This is a stronger probabilistic structural comparator, not an oracle.
strongest_controls.unconstrained_tabular: Independently fully trained Dirichlet(.25) for each of 16 (state,action) next-state cells; identical Beta(1,1) state reward model, all authentic source rows; two-action composition.
strongest_controls.invariant_xor: Independently fully trained action->state-XOR-delta Dirichlet(.25) across all source contexts; ignores state-dependent effects; same Beta reward training.
strongest_controls.random_sham: Uniform next-state and .5 terminal Bernoulli, not a meaningful comparator; negative only.

scoring.universal_probe: The evaluator exhaustively checks 4 initial states x 4 first actions x 4 second actions=64 identical two-action queries, reporting expected Bernoulli Brier against evaluator-private true stochastic two-step transition/reward probabilities. No probe truth or unchosen sampled outcome enters any training model.
scoring.metrics: Expected two-action terminal Brier by phases, witnessed real source counts, original old-source ledger retention, source/weights/cold SHA, wall/CPU and checkpoint size. Every arm has matched action IDs, genuine outcomes and number of training episodes but extra structural-gating computation is NOT matched.

fixed_go.decision: Any failure DEV_NO_GO. If all pass DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC, no strong-control superiority claim or scientific PASS until independent disjoint physics, matched cost, first-use authority and final regression.

negative_fixture: Generate separate engineer-only state-independent XOR and explicitly state-dependent/permutation-violating effects; demonstrate invariant-only cannot fit latter after all action-state cells witnessed, while a conditional model can. Verify all four action IDs, source/ledger/cold integrity and score read purity.
execution: Research-only branch, commit protocol before any implementation and first DEV source. Dedicated Ubuntu/Windows exact SHA workflow, fixture tests before one DEV screen, in-repo original receipts, no same-seed tuning or held first-use. No production native ref/controller/trading/scheduler/paid API/merge/deployment actions.
